title: Universal Door Foundation 美音基金會
content_html: The Universal Door Foundation was cofounded to bridge cultural and generational gaps in art between East and West and between young and old. The organization supports musicians financially and hosts community concerts to promote works that integrate Taiwanese folk music with modern genres such as jazz and classical. In 2013, the foundation funded and hosted the Formosan American Concert, which drew over five hundred attendees. The organization was also planning a follow-up concert in spring 2014.
